description: Removes a pitched component from the spectrum: channels carrying any pitch in the midimin-midimax range AND its harmonics (up to rangetop Hz) are attenuated by atten. Mode 1 removes the pitch and its harmonics; mode 2 removes EVERYTHING ELSE (keep-only complement - verified: on a harmonic gliss probe, mode 1 left -15.0 dBFS of residue while mode 2 kept only -35.3 dBFS of the tracked material; distinct renders). Banner guidance: keep the MIDI range small - a range of an octave or more removes the WHOLE spectrum between the lower pitch and rangetop. atten runs 0 to 1 with 1 = maximum removal (banner: '1 = max, 0 = none'). Static duration (2.0230); deterministic. Operates on PVOC analysis files (.ana).
musical_use: Spectral unpitching / pitch surgery: dial in the pitch you want gone (as a narrow MIDI window around it) and its whole harmonic stack fades by atten - pull a drone out from under a field recording, thin a fundamental to leave its halo, or (mode 2, execute()) isolate one pitch's harmonic skeleton from a mixture. atten is a depth control, not a switch: intermediate values duck the pitch rather than deleting it. rangetop bounds how far up the harmonic ladder the removal reaches - stop at 3-4 kHz to keep air and noise intact. Kin to spec bare (which KEEPS harmonics of a tracked pitch); remove needs no pitchfile, just a target range, so it works on material where pitch tracking fails.

midimin.description: Minimum pitch to remove (MIDI). 0 accepted on this build (afta8's 1-127 is a UI range). Keep the min-max window small (an octave or more removes everything between the lower pitch and rangetop, per banner).

midimax.description: Maximum pitch to remove (MIDI). A reversed pair (58 56) was accepted without complaint on this build - order tolerance, not documented.

rangetop.description: Frequency at which the search for harmonics stops (Hz).

atten.description: Attenuation of the suppressed components - 1 = maximum removal, 0 = none (banner sense). CDP-enforced 0 to 1 ('1.5' refused verbatim: 'Parameter[4] Value (1.500000) out of range (0.000000 to 1.000000)').

examples.description: Pull a G#3-ish drone and its harmonics out of a texture.
examples.expected_use: Narrow MIDI window around the target pitch; harmonic stack removed up to 6 kHz.
Half-depth removal keeps a ghost of the pitch under the rest of the material.

known_issues: A MIDI range of an octave or more removes the WHOLE spectrum between the lower pitch and rangetop (banner warning) - keep the window narrow for surgical work.
atten's sense is inverted versus its name: 1 = fully removed, 0 = no effect (banner-confirmed, range refusal verbatim).
Mode 2 (remove everything EXCEPT the pitch and its harmonics) verified running and distinct - execute(['specnu', 'remove', '2', ...]).
No breakpoint-capable parameters observed; midimin 0 and a reversed midimin/midimax pair were accepted silently on this build.
wav input refused; engine auto-PVOCs. Deterministic (byte-identical reruns).
